messages:
sam: thinking about a smallish change to the rerank API — can we support 'prefetch / tear-off' candidates so downstream services can do cheap prefetches and only pay for full scoring when they actually surface results?
elaine: :thinking_face: sketch the request/response shape? billing implications are my main worry (double counting).
mohit: +1 on the idea. key Q is model selection: prefetch should run on cheaper variants (quantized) and full score on higher-quality model. need explicit model affinity in the request.
sam: rough sketch:```json
{
  "candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"...","prefetch_only":true, "prefetch_budget":1}, ...],
  "score_mode": "deferred" // options: immediate | deferred | hybrid
}```
elaine: ok makes format explicit. but how do we surface quota units? do we charge prefetch units differently? we already have 'score_units' for full scoring.
paul: telemetry angle: we need to tag traces and metrics with `prefetch=true/false` and `model_variant` so console can show wasted prefetch vs converted-to-full. will need a small dashboard panel.
irene: from console/rollout POV, we should show conversion rate per tenant when we enable deferred scoring in a canary. toggles: global, org, route. UX should warn if prefetch increases token usage.
mohit: routing policy: prefer same-region cheaper variant for prefetch to keep latency low and not steal scarce high-end GPUs. also fallback rule: if prefetch variant fails, still allow full score path.
elaine: agree, propose differential billing: prefetch = 0.05 * full_score_unit (example). ops-bot: current quota for rerank per-tenant: 1M score_units/month, prefetch not tracked.
sam: can we add a 'prefetch_units' counter in quota service? small PR?
paul: also add metrics for conversion latency distribution and token delta (prefetch->full). console should graph per-route and per-tenant.
mohit: implementation note: KV-cache implications. if prefetch warms KV for a candidate, full scoring should reuse cached KV. ensure cache key includes model variant + prefix.
elaine: good call. KV cache reuse reduces double compute concerns but we still bill both ops. need to reconcile accounting.
irene: rollout plan suggestion: start with opt-in flag per-tenant, show conversion and cost delta in the UI, then enable auto-promotion after X% conversion and acceptable cost threshold.
sam: PR incoming with data model and API schema. will include unit tests for quota increments. tagging @paul for dashboard hooks.
paul: cool,I'll add telemetry events and draft a console mock. canary dashboard panel: conversion rate, extra tokens, model_variant breakdown.
devbot: deploy queued: rerank-api-spec-change branch -> integration tests (ETA ~45m) :gear:
elaine: once PR lands we should add an ops playbook line: "if conversion spikes >200% for 1h, mute prefetch for that tenant".
ops-bot: noted — will open a ticket to add quota counters and alert rule skeleton.
sam: thanks all. next sync if we hit blockers in PR reviews. :thumbsup:
